_note: Melee hit effects (MeleeHitFx), Ashwin's picks from the melee effects demo, 2026-11-02. kinds: a blow's kind (SpellFx.melee_kind) to its own settings: style (cut, ring, shock, ripple), angle in degrees from the blow's way across the screen (down is positive, a blow travelling left mirrors it), colours (palette names), size and length. Every kind keeps its own; nothing is shared.
